name: frontend-scan-deps
body: For every frontend, the spec names what must be resolvable on PATH for `apg scan` to produce a graph, and which frontends need nothing. The scan-time tools are: `go` for the Go frontend (`discoverModulesViaGoList` runs `go list -m`, and the frontend loads packages through `go/packages`, so the compiling toolchain is also its type-checker); `cargo` and `rustc` for the Rust frontend (`load_project` uses `RustLibSource::Discover` for the sysroot and `run_build_scripts` invokes cargo); `java` (JDK ≥ 21) for the Java frontend, spawned as `java -Xmx5g -cp <dir> CallGraphBuilder`; and `node` for the TypeScript frontend, spawned as `node <dir>/scanner.mjs`. The C++, C#, Python, and Markdown frontends need no scan-time toolchain (native or self-contained binaries; Python resolves from filesystem markers and never shells out).
